categories.main_business_segments: Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining Co., Ltd. primarily operates in gold and polymetallic mining, including mining, selection, and sales of gold, copper, zinc, lead, molybdenum, and rare earth elements. The company also engages in comprehensive resource recycling and environmental protection services through its subsidiary Guangyuan Technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs underground and open-pit mining methods, with beneficiation processes including flotation, all-slime cyanidation absorption, and carbon-in-pulp gold extraction. It utilizes advanced technologies such as AI-based video analysis for production monitoring, three-dimensional geological modeling, flotation and regrinding, flotation tailings resin leaching, and intelligent mine systems to improve efficiency and recovery rates.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include gold refineries with Shanghai Gold Exchange membership, large downstream smelting enterprises for concentrates, international gold refineries selected through tender for doré products, and international commodity traders for copper cathodes. End markets encompass central banks, investment sectors, jewelry, industrial applications, and infrastructure industries globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mines in China (Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Yunnan), Laos (Sepon Gold and Copper Mine and rare earth projects), and Ghana (Wassa Gold Mine). Its revenue is predominantly derived from overseas operations, accounting for approximately 69.5% of total revenue, with significant assets and operations in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chifeng Jilong operates primarily in the upstream segment of the mining supply chain, focusing on exploration, mining, ore processing, and production of precious and non-ferrous metals. It also engages in downstream sales through trading platforms and direct sales to refineries and smelters.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a 'focus on gold' strategy, expanding production capacity and reserves through exploration and acquisitions. It prioritizes technological innovation, including digital and intelligent mining transformations, process optimization, and cost control. R&D investments focus on improving recovery rates, flotation technologies, and sustainable mining practices, with a commitment to ESG and carbon neutrality goals by 2055.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of mined gold, copper cathodes, and concentrates of lead, zinc, molybdenum, and silver. Sales are conducted via spot price transactions on exchanges such as the Shanghai Gold Exchange and London Bullion Market Association, as well as through tendering processes and negotiated contracts with international and domestic customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chifeng Jilong ranks between 20th and 30th among global gold producers and is the fifth largest listed gold producer in China. It competes with major Chinese and international gold mining companies, leveraging its international presence, high-grade deposits, and cost advantages. The company benefits from experienced management and a broad overseas footprint compared to peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 9.03 billion, a 25% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to the parent company reaching RMB 1.76 billion, up 119%. Total assets were RMB 20.33 billion, growing 8.6% from the prior year. Gold production increased to 15.16 tonnes, marking steady growth. The company maintains strong cash flow and improved gearing ratios, reflecting robust financial health and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chifeng Jilong emphasizes high-grade mineral resources, cost-effective production, and technological innovation to deliver superior profitability and sustainable growth. Its international diversification, advanced mining technologies, and strong ESG commitments differentiate it in the market. The company fosters a collaborative corporate culture with employee shareholding plans to align incentives and drive operational excellence.
